author: Sideprojects
description: Some photographs become permanently seared into collective memory. But what happened to the people inside them? From child labourers photographed by Lewis Hine to the Migrant Mother, the Iwo Jima flag raisers, the Afghan Girl, and Kevin Carter's haunting Pulitzer-winning image, we trace their remarkable lives after the shutter clicked.
title: The Fate of People From History's Most Famous Images
